messages:
Maya (PM): ok folks — post-launch sync. We need to sculpt next sprint around customer signals: 3 high-severity bugs from enterprise, plus a few small UX asks. Goal: decide bugs vs enhancements split by EOD.
Jonah (Eng): can you list the three enterprise bugs? rough effort estimates help.
Maya (PM): 1) streaming token duplication (vip customers) — likely 3 dev-days + test. 2) embedding indexing delay causing search misses — ~5 dev-days, needs infra changes. 3) onboarding flow crash on Safari 16 — ~1 dev-day.
Elena (CS): streaming dup is causing 2 active escalations (ACME + NovaHealth). ACME threatened to pause Dedicated rollout if not fixed.
Ravi (Sales): ACME is on a committed plan. This is revenue-impacting. prioritize.
Priya (Design): onboarding crash has a simple fix, can do a hotpatch UX tweak and revert after.
Sam (SRE): embedding delay correlates with cold KV cache misses on nodes — we can add warmup warming for ~2 infra-days but it impacts capacity.
Jonah (Eng): rough capacity: if we pull 2 devs full sprint on bugs we can do streaming dup + onboarding fix. Embedding delay will need cross-team (infra + eng) and spills to next sprint unless we reprioritize.
Maya (PM): proposal: immediate P0 for streaming dup (customer/contract risk) and onboarding crash, P1 embedding delay. Remaining small UX asks go to backlog or a follow-on micro-sprint. Thoughts?
Priya (Design): agree. Also recommend we ship a mitigator for embedding: temporary cache TTL tweak + doc for customers. Low effort.
Elena (CS): we can propose the mitigator to ACME as a short-term fix while full embedding work is scheduled. They’ll accept it.
Ravi (Sales): confirm — if we commit to streaming fix within next 10 business days and provide mitigator for embedding, ACME stays. I'll update contract owner.
Maya (PM): decision checklist I used: customer SLA risk, revenue impact, effort, cross-team blockers. Rank: streaming dup (P0), onboarding crash (P0), embedding delay (P1 mitigator), UX polish (P3).
triage-bot: NOTE: rolling-forward assigned labels — streaming-dup -> P0, onboarding-safari -> P0, embedding-delay -> P1 (mitigator suggested).
Jonah (Eng): plan: 2 engineers on streaming dup (start tomorrow), 1 engineer + Priya do onboarding patch, infra handles cache mitigator in parallel. Can cut a canary deploy window Fri AM.
Sam (SRE): will reserve time for the canary and monitor p99. I’ll add tracing hooks to track token duplication source.
Priya (Design): will prepare the small onboarding microcopy + repro steps for QA.
Maya (PM): OK — owners: Jonah -> streaming dup, Priya -> onboarding hotpatch, Sam -> embedding mitigator infra, Elena -> customer comms. Everyone agree?
Elena (CS): agree. I’ll draft the customer note and send to Ravi for redlines.
Ravi (Sales): will echo it to ACME and NovaHealth after review.
Jonah (Eng): one ask: can product accept a slightly narrower rollback window if the canary surfaces issues? we need flexibility.
Maya (PM): yes — we’ll add rollback clause in the deploy plan. Sam, add that to runbook.
Sam (SRE): done. adding rollback steps + playbook link: https://docs.redwood.internal/playbooks/postdeploy-rollback
Maya (PM): follow-up: please add tickets with estimates by EOD and tag with #postlaunch-hotfix. I’ll update the sprint board.
Jonah (Eng): will create tickets.
Priya (Design): will attach mocks to onboarding ticket.
Elena (CS): will paste customer repro logs into embedding ticket.
Maya (PM): thanks. Quick checklist before we close: commitments, owners, canary window Fri AM, customer comms draft by tomorrow noon. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
